Generate a GBIF occurrence map cropped to a geographic boundary

Source: R/spatial_gbif.R
gbif_map_crop.Rd

gbif_map_crop() creates a standalone map of the georeferenced occurrences of a species within a geographic boundary, and gbif_map_crop_md() creates the same map for a markdown-formatted report (Quarto or R Markdown).

gbif_map_crop(
  species,
  kml = NULL,
  crop_area = NULL,
  crop_box = NULL,
  limit = 100000L,
  mode = c("interactive", "static"),
  save_occurrences = FALSE,
  export_image = FALSE,
  directory = getwd(),
  colour = NULL,
  dpi = NULL,
  ppp = NULL,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  distribution = c("local", "global"),
  source = c("gbif", "local"),
  local_export = c("species", "crop")
)

gbif_map_crop_md(
  species,
  kml = NULL,
  crop_area = NULL,
  crop_box = NULL,
  limit = 100000L,
  mode = NULL,
  save_occurrences = FALSE,
  export_image = FALSE,
  directory = getwd(),
  colour = NULL,
  dpi = NULL,
  ppp = NULL,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  distribution = c("local", "global"),
  fig_width = NULL,
  fig_height = NULL,
  source = c("gbif", "local"),
  local_export = c("species", "crop")
)

Arguments

species

A binomial scientific name in the form "Genus species", e.g. "Bidens andicola". GBIF must resolve it as an exact species-level name; approximate and higher-rank matches are rejected.

kml

Path to a .kml file whose geometry defines the crop extent and is drawn as the map outline. The file name provides the place name used in captions and in the export directory. It cannot be combined with crop_area.

crop_area

Geographic area name or code resolved against Natural Earth's administrative gazetteer, such as "Ecuador" or "EC". Its complete administrative name is used in captions and legends, unless crop_box provides a label. It cannot be combined with kml.

crop_box

Rectangular crop in WGS 84 decimal degrees, given as c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax): west and east longitude, south and north latitude, e.g. c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6). A fifth element, a character string, sets the crop label, e.g. c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6, "Ecuador continental"). Every rectangular crop adds an area item to the map legend: it uses this label when present and otherwise uses the formatted rectangle coordinates, e.g. "82.5°W, 5.5°S, 75°W, 1.6°N". A supplied label also replaces the area name in captions and the export directory. It can be used alone or together with kml or crop_area; in the latter case it must overlap the boundary. The map is framed on the rectangle, which is not drawn. With distribution = "global" all records are still mapped, but only those inside the frame are visible. Defaults to NULL (no rectangular crop).

limit

Maximum number of georeferenced occurrences used to draw the map, an integer between 1 and 100000. Defaults to 100000.

mode

Map type: "interactive" (default; a Leaflet widget) or "static" (a ggplot2 map). In gbif_map_crop_md(), NULL selects an interactive map for HTML output and a static map for other formats.

save_occurrences

Logical. If TRUE, the records located within the area, its boundary, and a provenance file containing the validated GBIF taxon key and exact name match are saved under sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/Place. Defaults to FALSE.

export_image

Logical. If TRUE, the static map is written as a PNG file to sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/Place. Defaults to FALSE.

directory

Base directory in which sacha_exports is created or, for a local source, searched. Occurrences and exported images are saved under sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/Place. Defaults to getwd().

colour

Colour of the occurrence points as a hexadecimal code with 3, 4, 6, or 8 digits, e.g. "#1B9E77". When NULL, the package default colour is used.

dpi

Resolution of the exported PNG in dots per inch. When NULL, the package default resolution is used.

ppp

Spanish-language synonym of dpi (puntos por pulgada). If both are supplied, ppp takes precedence.

overwrite

Logical. Should existing output files be replaced? If FALSE, an existing local occurrence export raises an error. Defaults to TRUE.

distribution

Geographic distribution of the mapped records: "local" (default) restricts them to the area; "global" includes all records of the species.

source

Occurrence source: "gbif" (default) retrieves records from GBIF; "local" reads a saved export from sacha_exports under directory.

local_export

Saved export used when source = "local": "species" (default) reads the full-extent export of the species and applies the area; "crop" reads the export saved for the area. It is ignored when source = "gbif".

fig_width, fig_height

Figure dimensions in inches, used only by gbif_map_crop_md(). When NULL, dimensions are chosen from the aspect ratio of the map.

Value

A Leaflet widget or a ggplot2 object. Paths of the written files are stored in the "sacha_files" attribute, the plotted records in "sacha_occurrences", the species in "sacha_species", and the resolved place name in "sacha_crop_place". gbif_map_crop_md() returns the map formatted for the report output.

Details

The area to map is defined with kml, crop_area, or crop_box. kml and crop_area are mutually exclusive and define a boundary that is drawn as the map outline; crop_box defines a rectangle and can be used alone or together with either of them. With distribution = "local" (default), only records inside the area are mapped. With distribution = "global", all available georeferenced records are mapped and the boundary, when there is one, is kept as a reference outline.

When crop_box is combined with kml or crop_area, the boundary is clipped to the rectangle and the map is framed on the rectangle, so that only the part of the area that falls inside it is shown; the rectangle itself is not drawn. For example, crop_area = "EC" maps Ecuador including the Galapagos Islands, whereas adding crop_box = c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6, "Ecuador continental") maps only the continental part of the country. When crop_box is used alone, the map is framed on the rectangle and no outline is drawn. Clipping is performed in planar longitude/latitude coordinates, so the edges of the rectangle follow the meridians and parallels given.

With source = "gbif" (default), the supplied binomial is first resolved as an exact, species-level name in the configured GBIF checklist (COL Extended Release by default). Its taxon key and that same checklist key are then used for the occurrence query, preventing approximate or higher-rank name matches. With source = "local", GBIF is not contacted and records are read from a saved export under sacha_exports in directory, in one of two ways set by local_export:

  • "species" (default): the full-extent export of the species (sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species), produced by save_occurrences = TRUE in gbif_map() or by gbif_save_occurrences(). The area is applied to these records exactly as it is applied to records retrieved from GBIF. This is the only option compatible with distribution = "global".

  • "crop": an export previously saved for the same area (sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/Place), which contains the filtered records and the stored boundary. It requires distribution = "local". When the export was saved with a crop_box, the same crop_box (and therefore the same label) must be supplied to identify it.

Interactive maps show the scientific name, year, locality, and observer (recordedBy) reported by GBIF for each occurrence. Missing values are displayed as unavailable.

Setting save_occurrences = TRUE stores the records located inside the area and its boundary, whatever the value of distribution, in sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/Place within directory, where Place is the name of the area or, when crop_box is supplied, its label. If crop_box is supplied, the stored records and boundary are those inside the rectangle; when crop_box is used alone, the stored boundary is the rectangle itself. Records are not truncated by limit. Three files are written: occurrences.gpkg (records in WGS 84, EPSG:4326), boundary.gpkg, and metadata.json (query, retrieval date, coordinate reference system, and record count). With distribution = "global" the map still shows all records, but only those inside the area are saved; if none falls inside, nothing is saved and a warning is issued. When the records come from the full-extent local export, the metadata retain the original GBIF provenance and add a derived_from entry and the processing date, so that a crop produced offline has the same traceability as one produced from GBIF. If the records were read from a cropped local export, they are already saved and nothing is written.

Setting export_image = TRUE writes the static map as a PNG file, whatever the value of mode, to the same directory as the saved files (sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/Place). With distribution = "global" the file prefix is gbif_map_crop_global, so that the image does not replace that of the cropped map.

In Markdown reports, the crop figure ID has the form fig-gbif-map-crop-bidens_andicola-<place>, where <place> is the lower-case, ASCII-normalised area name or crop label. For example, crop_area = "Ecuador" yields fig-gbif-map-crop-bidens_andicola-ecuador; the label "Ecuador continental" yields fig-gbif-map-crop-bidens_andicola-ecuador_continental. A KML map uses its resolved place name. Use the resulting ID as @fig-gbif-map-crop-... in report prose; distribution, source, and mode do not change the ID. For generated Markdown figures, set results: asis on the Quarto or R Markdown chunk.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
map <- gbif_map_crop("Bidens andicola", kml = "Ecuador.kml", limit = 100)
map

gbif_map_crop("Bidens andicola", crop_area = "EC",
              crop_box = c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6, "Ecuador continental"))

gbif_map_crop("Bidens andicola",
              crop_box = c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6))

gbif_save_occurrences("Bidens andicola")
gbif_map_crop("Bidens andicola", crop_area = "Ecuador", source = "local",
              save_occurrences = TRUE, export_image = TRUE)
gbif_map_crop("Bidens andicola", crop_area = "Ecuador", source = "local",
              local_export = "crop")

gbif_map_crop_md("Bidens andicola", crop_area = "Ecuador",
                  source = "gbif", distribution = "local")
gbif_map_crop_md("Bidens andicola", crop_area = "Ecuador",
                  crop_box = c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6,
                               "Ecuador continental"),
                  source = "gbif", distribution = "global", mode = "static",
                  save_occurrences = TRUE, export_image = TRUE,
                  colour = "#1B9E77", ppp = 300, overwrite = TRUE,
                  fig_width = 8, fig_height = 6)
gbif_map_crop_md("Bidens andicola",
                  crop_box = c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6,
                               "Ecuador continental"),
                  source = "gbif", distribution = "local")
gbif_map_crop_md("Bidens andicola", kml = "study_boundary.kml",
                  source = "gbif", distribution = "local", mode = "static",
                  export_image = TRUE)
gbif_map_crop_md("Bidens andicola", kml = "study_boundary.kml",
                  crop_box = c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6,
                               "study area detail"),
                  source = "gbif", distribution = "global")
gbif_map_crop_md("Bidens andicola", crop_area = "Ecuador",
                  source = "local", local_export = "species",
                  distribution = "global")
gbif_map_crop_md("Bidens andicola", crop_area = "Ecuador",
                  source = "local", local_export = "crop",
                  distribution = "local")
gbif_map_crop_md("Bidens andicola", crop_area = "Ecuador",
                  crop_box = c(-82.5, -5.5, -75.0, 1.6,
                               "Ecuador continental"),
                  source = "local", local_export = "crop",
                  distribution = "local")
} # }
